summary: Evaluates two quadratic polynomials a2^2*C2 + a2*C1 + C0 with double-precision coefficients read from the struct, writing the first result to *a3 and the second to *a4. When the enable flag byte at this+0x0 is zero, both outputs are set to 0.0. Returns the a3 pointer when enabled, the a4 pointer when disabled.

operations.description: if *this (enable flag byte at this+0x0) is non-zero, evaluate both quadratics; otherwise zero both outputs
polynomial 1: *a3 = a2*a2*C2 + a2*C1 + C0 with C0 at this+0x4, C1 at this+0xC, C2 at this+0x14 (all doubles)
polynomial 2: *a4 = a2*a2*C2' + a2*C1' + C0' with C0' at this+0x1C, C1' at this+0x24, C2' at this+0x2C (all doubles)
disabled path sets both outputs to 0.0: *a3 = 0.0; *a4 = 0.0
return the result pointer: a3 when enabled, a4 when disabled
